description: Correct a lot the engine derived, naming it by the transfer it opened from. Asserts at least one of unit price, acquisition time, or origin lot. Quantity is never editable: the account's real balance is ground truth.

acquisitionTime.description: Corrected acquisition time. ISO 8601, must be in the past.

anchorOriginLotId.description: Origin lot currently on the lot being edited ('originLotId'). Part of the lot's identity, not a new value.

originLotId.description: Corrected lot this one carries basis from

smartAccountId.description: Account id the lot belongs to (from 'accounts list')

sourceTransferId.description: Transfer the lot opened from ('sourceTransferId' on the lot)

unitPrice.description: Corrected cost basis per whole token, in USD

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounting_assertions_edit
